edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open.
edits.reason: "Open" is the ordinary general-knowledge antonym of "closed" (the key word in "fail-closed"); the trailer adds nothing beyond stating that closed is not open.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
